scripts.title: Stand Script
scripts.features:
Stand cmds

-- how to multi-target?
-- example: .k user1 user2
--          .lk user1 user2
--          .watchlk user1 user2

.s -- summon the stand
.v -- hide / void the stand

.left -- stand position left
.right -- stand position right
.change char -- saitama, bald, genos, garou, hunter, batter, blade, esper, ninja, purple, tech, zombie

.k @user -- kill once (single or multiple)
.lk @user -- loop kill (single or multiple)
.kstando @user -- detects a stand user and uses a different attack method
.lkstando @user -- same but loopkill
.watchlk @user -- loop kill + track leave/rejoin
.watchlk off

.kb @user -- stay behind target, then send 1-4
.kb off

.f @user -- fling target
.bring @user -- hunter skill 
.b @user -- same as .bring
.throw @user -- throw trash can (owner can use .throw me)
.void @user -- hunter void (skill 1 or 2)
.hv @user -- same as .void
.ult -- activate ult

.op -- owner protect toggle
.sp -- stand protect toggle
.m1block -- M1 when owner blocks
.exploiter -- unpredictable vs other exploits
.exploiter off
.formation -- sync stands
.inv -- invisible mode
.inv off
.toxic -- taunt after kills
.toxic off

.enable -- chat 1-4: stand comes in front and uses skill
.disable
1 -- use skill 1 (after .enable or during .kb)
2 -- use skill 2
3 -- use skill 3
4 -- use skill 4 (hunter skips 4)

.tp me place
.tp @user place

places:
safe, mountain1, mountain2, jail, death, middle, corner

.br @user -- bring target to you

.owner @user -- temporary owner
.backup -- restore original owner
.rejoin -- rejoin server
.cmds -- show commands

.unfreeze -- unfreeze stand

-- Premium
.freeze -- freeze stand
.betray @user -- steal stand
.kick @user -- kick other free stands
.ban @user -- ban other free stands
(You can use it on specific free users or on all free users in the server)
